categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai REFIRE Group Limited primarily operates in the hydrogen technology sector, focusing on the design, development, manufacture, and sales of hydrogen fuel cell systems, hydrogen production systems, and related core components. The company also provides fuel cell engineering and technical services, offering one-stop solutions for hydrogen production and end-use applications across diverse sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced hydrogen energy technologies including fuel cell stacks, membrane electrode assemblies (MEAs), bipolar plates, hydrogen circulation systems, and DC-to-DC boost converters. It continuously optimizes production processes such as membrane electrode manufacturing and intelligent assembly technologies for fuel cell stacks, and develops control algorithms tailored for heavy-duty truck logistics scenarios. The company also develops hydrogen ultrafast charging equipment and invests in forward-looking R&D for next-generation products and core material customization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include commercial vehicle manufacturers, industrial systems integrators, and power systems integrators mainly based in China. The company serves markets involving hydrogen-powered heavy-duty trucks, fuel cell vehicles, off-grid ultra-fast charging, green drilling, mining machinery, port ships, rail transit, and other hydrogen energy applications. Major customers contribute significant portions of revenue, with the top five accounting for over 60% of total revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanghai REFIRE Group Limited operates predominantly in Mainland China, with most non-current assets located there. The company has expanded its presence internationally, focusing on markets in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South America. Overseas revenue has grown significantly, supported by international certifications and collaborations, including projects in Chile, Saudi Arabia, and Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the hydrogen energy supply chain. It develops and manufactures core components and systems for hydrogen fuel cells and hydrogen production, and provides engineering and technical services. It also engages in integrated green hydrogen projects encompassing production, storage, transportation, and utilization, collaborating with upstream and downstream partners to build a hydrogen energy ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing commercialization of hydrogen energy technologies, especially focusing on heavy-duty trucks and expanding application scenarios. The company emphasizes technological innovation to improve performance, reliability, longevity, environmental adaptability, and cost-effectiveness. It invests in R&D for fuel cell systems, hydrogen production equipment, and next-generation products, while promoting integrated green hydrogen ecosystem projects and expanding global market footprint.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of hydrogen fuel cell systems and components, sales of hydrogen production systems and related components, provision of fuel cell engineering and technical services, and after-sales services including hydrogen energy vehicles sales. The company also benefits from government grants and subsidies related to its R&D and production activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai REFIRE Group Limited positions itself as a leading hydrogen technology company in China with a comprehensive technology layout across the entire industrial chain of fuel cells and hydrogen production systems. It leads in installation volumes for heavy-duty trucks and is the first Chinese company to achieve overseas commercial applications. The company collaborates with major industry players such as Sinopec and CATL, and maintains strategic partnerships to strengthen its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB648.8 million, a 27.5% decrease year-on-year, with gross profit of RMB111.8 million and a gross margin of 17.2%. The company recorded a loss attributable to owners of RMB737.3 million but showed an 11.5% year-on-year decrease in adjusted net loss (non-IFRS) to RMB417.0 million. Total assets stood at RMB4.69 billion with liabilities of RMB2.75 billion. The company was successfully listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2024, raising net proceeds of approximately HK$619.9 million to fund R&D, production capacity expansion, overseas market growth, and working capital.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop hydrogen technology solutions covering the entire supply chain from hydrogen production to end-use applications. It differentiates itself through advanced R&D capabilities, continuous product optimization, and strong performance in heavy-duty truck fuel cell systems that meet stringent operational requirements. Its integrated green hydrogen projects and global market expansion further enhance its competitive positioning by offering sustainable, reliable, and cost-effective hydrogen energy solutions.
